compass.label: Navigation compass; the red dot indicates the viewing direction.
compass.bearing: Viewing direction: {{degrees}}° from north. Indicated by the red dot.

status.idle: Set your location to load the stars.

surface.label: Show central surface
surface.help: A subtle grid and rings with an adjustable dark background. The surface fades when zooming in.

darkness.label: Ground darkness
darkness.help: Adjust the background darkness without changing the grid or rings.

solar.label: Sun and Moon
solar.help: Positions and angular sizes calculated for your location and the selected time. The Moon shows its phase and lighting. Atmospheric refraction is not simulated.
solar.invalid: The Sun and Moon positions could not be read. Please try again.
solar.expired: The Sun and Moon positions have expired. Refresh them to continue.

guides.locationRequired: Set your position in Location to orient these guides in your sky.

constellations.label: Constellations (88)
constellations.help: Lines for all 88 constellations and names of the figures you are looking toward. They follow your location and the selected time.

ecliptic.label: Ecliptic
ecliptic.help: The Sun's apparent yearly path. Its tilt relative to the horizon changes with your location and the selected time.

equatorial.label: RA/Dec grid
equatorial.help: Right ascension in hours and declination in degrees, referenced to J2000. The grid rotates with the sky.
